lines.japanese: 「……羽田君」
lines.english: “...Haneda.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 制服を着て身支度を整えた山科さんが、背中を向けたまま声をかけてきた。
lines.english: Dressed once more in her uniform and ready to leave, Yamashina spoke to me without turning around.

lines.japanese: 「ん……えっと」
「なに、どうしたの？　何でも言って」
lines.english: “What is it? You can tell me anything.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ちょっと幸せすぎて、頭がぼやけてるんだけど……なんて言えばいいのかな」
lines.english: “Ahaha. I’m a little too happy to think straight... How am I supposed to put this?”

lines.japanese: 振りむきかけた山科さんの、少し躊躇いがちに開く口元が見えた。
lines.english: Yamashina started to turn, and I glimpsed her lips part with a trace of hesitation.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君は、私だけを見てくれてるんだよね」
lines.english: “I'm the only one you have eyes for, aren't I?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前じゃない。おれは山科さんだけが好きだよ」
lines.english: “Of course. You're the only one I love.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、嬉しい……そう言ってくれるのは羽田君だけだよ」
lines.english: “Mm. That makes me so happy... You’re the only person who says that to me.”

lines.japanese: 「私ね、もう羽田君しかいないから、自分自身の心も裏切りたくないんだ」
lines.english: “You see, you're all I have now. So I don't want to betray my own heart either.”

lines.japanese: 「いつまでも逃げてられないから、近いうちにけじめをつけにいきたいの。そのときは私が逃げないようそばに居てくれるかな」
lines.english: “I can't keep running forever. Sometime soon, I want to go and settle things properly. When I do, will you stay beside me and make sure I don't run away?”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは胸に手を当てているみたいだ。
lines.english: Yamashina seemed to have one hand pressed to her chest.

lines.japanese: ひじの角度からして、両手を合わせてるのかな。そういえば、合い鍵を持ってるって言ってた。けじめってそのことなんだろうか。
lines.english: Judging by the angle of her elbows, perhaps she had clasped both hands together. Come to think of it, she had said she still had a spare key. Was that what she meant by settling things?

lines.japanese: 「うん、一緒に行こう。大丈夫、もしその時にどうしても辛くて耐えられなかったら、何度でも付き合うよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. We’ll go together. And if it’s simply too painful to bear when the time comes, that’s all right. I’ll go with you as many times as you need.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、ありがとう。頼りにしてるから」
lines.english: “Thank you, Haneda. I'm counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「もし羽田君が居なくなったら、私はこの世に存在しないと同じだから……私のこと見捨てないでね」
lines.english: “If you ever disappeared, it would be the same as if I no longer existed in this world... Please don't abandon me.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことしないってば。おれのこと信じてよ」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, I would never do that. Please, believe me.”

lines.japanese: 「分かってるよ、羽田君だけは信じてる。だから絶対に裏切らないでね」
lines.english: “I know. You're the one person I do believe in. So please—never betray me.”

lines.japanese: うーん、信じてるなら、裏切ると思わないはずなんだけどな……でも不安みたいだから、安心させてあげたいな。
lines.english: Hmm. If she believed in me, surely she wouldn't think I might betray her... But she was frightened, and I wanted to put her mind at ease.

lines.japanese: 「あるひとに私の気持ちは重すぎるって言われちゃったけど、羽田君は受けとめてくれるよね」
lines.english: “Someone once told me my feelings were too much. But they aren’t too much for you, are they?”

lines.japanese: 「重い？　そんな風に思ったことないよ」
lines.english: “Too much? I’ve never felt that way.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、どうして羽田君はそんなに優しいんだろう……ありがとう。大好きだよ」
lines.english: “Oh, how can you be so kind...? Thank you. I love you.”

lines.japanese: はは、照れちゃうな。僕はこれ以上の言葉は必要ないと思って、山科さんを後ろから抱きしめた。
lines.english: Ha ha. Now she had me blushing. Deciding we needed no more words, I wrapped my arms around Yamashina from behind.

lines.japanese: 「これから家に帰っても、私の心だけは羽田君の元に置いてくから。ずっと抱きしめててね」
lines.english: “Even after I go home, I'll leave my heart here with you. Hold it close forever, all right?”

lines.japanese: 振りかえりざま、彼女の腕が伸びてきて、僕の首にしゅるりと巻きついてきた。僕が目を閉じると、引きよせられた先に柔らかな唇の感触が待っていた。
lines.english: As she turned, she slipped her arms around my neck. I closed my eyes, and she drew me close, her lips soft against mine.
